title: Captain's Meeting + blind draw
body:
The Captain's Meeting for Fall 2026 will be held on Thu, Aug 13 at [O'Malley's Sports Pub](https://maps.app.goo.gl/23T6j3KE9od9yS3M6) at 7:30pm.

Each team must have a member in attendance (preferably the captain), or be penalized a match point. We use this meeting to familiarize each team with the schedule and discuss any significant updates within the league. We will also hand out season packets (which include score sheets). The meeting is open to all (not just captains)!

The intention is to wrap up the meeting quickly, such that those interested can jet over to Beefy's for their Thursday off-season ~815pm blind draw tournament (run by Dave from Dartgasm).

title: Fall 2026 Season important dates
body:
June 30 is the [team registration deadline](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdjsKEOmK4gLd11in1l5xiPsrSXgdMEZu2yQdqhQ4sWgFyC3w/viewform?usp=header) for Fall 2026. Register your team asap if you can!

Aug 13: Captain's meeting at TBD
Aug 20: Week 1

title: Banquet recap
body:
Thanks to everyone who came out to Beefy's on June 18 to celebrate the Spring 2026 season! Check out our [banquet highlight reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DZy2ivQMBkn/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==)!

Congrats to Reu/Sammy on their tournament win, and to Pros/Joe for the second-place finish.

And another congrats to your division winners:

body:

title: Spring 2026 season underway
body: May 21 will be the last regular season match for B division. May 28 will be the last regular season match for A and C divisions.

title: Spring Season starts today!
body: Welcome to Week 1 of Spring 2026. Don't forget to submit pictures of your scoresheets after your match.
